last.verdict: Moderna swung to a profit on strong international COVID vaccine sales and raised its 2026 outlook, but much of the cash jump is borrowed money.

takeaways.label: Profitable quarter, higher outlook
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 29% to $1.3B, mostly international COVID sales, giving $162M net income versus a $200M loss a year ago. Full-year growth now seen at 15–25%, up from up to 10%.

takeaways.label: Cash boost is mostly borrowing
takeaways.text: Year-end cash outlook jumped to $8.1–8.3B from $4.7–5.2B, but $2.6B of that is net proceeds from convertible debt. Most Q3 sales were still uncollected at quarter-end.

takeaways.label: Melanoma shot works, flu launch small
takeaways.text: Intismeran plus Keytruda cut melanoma recurrence or death risk 42% in Phase 3, with regulatory filings being prepared. The flu shot won FDA approval in August but launches only in limited form this season.

takeaways.label: Spending down, norovirus stalled
takeaways.text: R&D fell 27% to $583M and 2026 R&D guidance dropped to about $2.7B from $2.9B. The norovirus vaccine gets no new trial cohort this season; its path forward is undecided.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
